draft.text: You came in because you have been having headaches on the top of your head.
These headaches come and go and are accompanied by dizziness and blurry vision.
You also mentioned having chest pain that feels like pressure, not sharp or dull.
We did not find any specific results from tests or exams during this visit.
However, you have a history of high blood pressure and diabetes.
Your headaches may be related to your high blood pressure, which is not well-controlled.
You are not taking your medication regularly because of stomachaches.
You will be advised to take your medication regularly and keep track of your blood pressure.
You will need to return for follow-up appointments to monitor your blood pressure and headache symptoms.
